status: Requested country benchmark metrics unavailable in the verified sources inspected. Combined 2024-25 State Pension outturn is available as context only.

state_pension_bn.note: Combined State Pension nominal outturn only; no basic/new decomposition.

basic_state_pension_bn.reason: Country/regional SP sheet has only combined State Pension expenditure; Spring 2026 State Pension sheet has no England/Scotland/Wales component split.

new_state_pension_bn.reason: Country/regional SP sheet has only combined State Pension expenditure; Spring 2026 State Pension sheet has no England/Scotland/Wales component split.

recipients_m.reason: Country/regional tables provide expenditure rather than annual caseloads. The verified benefits statistical release provides quarterly point-in-time State Pension statistics, not financial-year country recipients.

country_forecasts.reason: DWP guidance explicitly limits country/regional tables to outturn years. The published 2024-25 regional workbook ends at 2024-25; the committed Spring 2026 State Pension forecast has no country split.

country_region.conversion: Published numeric cell divided by 1000; no geographic allocation or forecast extrapolation.
country_region.methodology_section: About the Benefit expenditure by Country and Region tables
country_region.scope: Combined State Pension expenditure for residents of each named country. The source separately lists overseas/unknown; no overseas share is allocated here. DWP estimates geographic expenditure from National Statistics caseload and average payments applied to total outturn.

spring_2026.finding: National expenditure and financial-year caseload forecasts, basic/new components and overseas totals; no England/Scotland/Wales State Pension breakdown. Other benefits may have country rows.

country_of_residence.finding: Great Britain and overseas countries of residence; no England/Scotland/Wales split or annual recipient series.

benefits_statistics.finding: Point-in-time State Pension statistics; cannot substitute for a financial-year mean caseload. Detailed statistics link to Stat-Xplore, rather than a published annual country forecast table.

no_derived_benchmarks: No basic/new split, recipient series, country share or forecast is derived from the combined published expenditure.
